description: This file defines the 'Message' class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing messaging structures for the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes enums, properties, and methods related to message metadata such as headers, routing, response types, and flags.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a network message with headers, routing info, response types, flags, and utility methods for serialization and state interrogation.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the message, implementing IFormattable.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the message into a character span for efficient string generation.

methods.name: IsExpirableMessage
methods.description: Determines whether the message is subject to expiration based on its target grain ID and message direction.

methods.name: AddToCacheInvalidationHeader
methods.description: Adds cache invalidation update entries to the message header.

methods.name: GetTimeToLiveMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns the remaining TTL in milliseconds.

methods.name: SetTimeToLiveMilliseconds
methods.description: Sets the TTL for the message in milliseconds.

methods.name: SetInfiniteTimeToLive
methods.description: Clears the TTL, making the message have infinite lifespan.

methods.name: IsPing
methods.description: Checks whether the message is a ping message based on its request context data.
